checks.invariant: Generated deployment requires Vercel access; permitted anonymous API is test-mode and no-store.
Direct SQL uses the approved isolated database and restricted runtime with verified TLS.
Hosted staff login issues a Secure/HttpOnly/SameSite cookie and stores only its opaque-token hash in approved SQL.
UI-created event is durable in approved SQL; identical create retry returns its original receipt.
UI Add lot, edits and bulk window assignment save complete data; held pending save cannot display Saved before acknowledgement.
UI reorder matches complete SQL order; actual A catalog and lot show saved content.
An independent empty-storage browser reloads the same hosted event and complete saved lot.
